name: Anika Patel
psychographics: Optimistic and busy; tries to eat healthy but often runs out of time between meetings and grocery runs.
current_solutions: Instacart for same-day delivery from Waitrose; uses the 'split basket' feature to share costs with a colleague.
frustration: Yesterday at 2:15pm, her Instacart order was cancelled mid-checkout because the avocados were 'out of stock', and she had to walk to the corner shop paying full price for one salad.
decision_style: Reads the first three reviews on Amazon Fresh before adding anything to her cart.
voice: Rambling and apologetic; often starts sentences with 'Sorry, but...' even when not at fault.
